channel.title: M9G (Minsu Chang, Ph.D. / 장민수 / mincasurong) — Robotics, Physical AI & Agentic Systems
channel.description: Official portfolio and engineering blog of Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수, mincasurong, M9G): 1st-Place Winner at Google Gemini 3 Seoul Hackathon 2026, Multi-Robot VLA Benchmarks in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 & ROS 2, ROS/MoveIt/Jetson Nano Tutorials, 21 Peer-Reviewed Publications (IEEE ICRA, IEEE/RSJ IROS, IEEE TNSRE), and 14+ US/KR Patents.

item.title: Learning from UIUC's Lazy-DaSH (IEEE T-RO): Hierarchical Hypergraph Task & Motion Planning and Our Multi-Model VLA Upgrade Roadmap for IsaacSim_Gemini
item.description: M9G-TR-2026-05 by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G): Summarizing Seongwon "Scott" Lee et al.'s Lazy-DaSH (UIUC Parasol Lab, IEEE T-RO, arXiv:2504.05552) and mapping its 4-layer lazy hypergraph & branch-scoped constraint feedback onto Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini Robotics-ER 2, and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite in IsaacSim_Gemini with 7 continuous KPIs.

item.title: SOTA Survey (2025–2026): Agentic Multi-Robot Manipulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim — Assembly, Deformable Handling & Self-Driving Labs
item.description: M9G-TR-2026-04 by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G): 4-tier neuro-symbolic + GPU physics synthesis across 14 SOTA frameworks (MATTERIX, APEX-MR, RoboFactory, DexGarmentLab, ORGANA, A-Lab GPSS) and Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 and ROS 2 Jazzy.

item.title: Project STAMP: Decoupling Multimodal VLA Reasoning from Robot Execution via Deterministic Pre-Dispatch Gating and Fault Write-Back
item.description: M9G-TR-2026-03 by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G): A 4-stage closed-loop Spatial, Task & Motion Planning (STAMP) framework (Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back) achieving 100% deterministic fault interception and 100% episode completion across 1,000 multi-arm episodes.

item.title: Building a Multi-Agent Coding Harness from Scratch and Why It Failed: Inside m9g-agent-corps vs. OmO, OpenCode, Claude Code, and Antigravity
item.description: M9G-TR-2026-02 by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G): What we investigated across 28 Python modules and 169 unit tests while building m9g-agent-corps, why our standalone harness failed against OmO, OpenCode, Claude Code, and Antigravity, and how we pivoted its substrates into the m9g-mcp power-tool server.

item.title: Symbolic 3D Grounding and Software-Pipelined VLA Task Planning: ER-2 vs. Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: M9G-TR-2026-01 by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G): Benchmarking Gemini Robotics-ER 2, Gemini 4 Argon, and hybrid Argon + Flash-Lite task planners on 3 Franka Emika FR3 robotic arms in Isaac Sim 6.0 (-76.6% API cost at $0.01972).

item.title: ROS 2, MoveIt 2 & NVIDIA Jetson Nano Camera Vision Tutorials Hub (12 Hands-On Modules)
item.description: Complete hands-on robotics manipulation, mobile navigation, and NVIDIA Jetson Nano SSD-MobileNet / TensorRT transfer learning tutorials by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수, mincasurong, M9G).
